|gr1= GUI Control - Event Handlers

|gr2= Event Handlers

|descr= Remove a given event handler from the given display.

|s1= display [[displayRemoveEventHandler]] [handlerType, id]

|p1= display: [[Display]]

|p2= handlerType: [[String]] - type of the event handler

|p3= id: [[Number]] - index of the event handler

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>findDisplay 46 displayRemoveEventHandler ["keyDown",5];</sqf>

|seealso= [[disableSerialization]] [[Display]] [[displayAddEventHandler]] [[displayRemoveAllEventHandlers]]
}}

<dl class="command_description">

<dt></dt>
<dd class="notedate">Posted on 2015-04-19 - 21:25 (UTC)</dd>
<dt class="note">[[User:Nelis75733126|Nelis75733126]]</dt>
<dd class="note">
If you for example used this code to add the eventHandler:
<sqf>_myEH = findDisplay 46 displayAddEventHandler ["KeyDown", "hint str _this"];</sqf>
Then later in that same script you can use the <sqf inline>_myEH</sqf> private variable to remove that same eventHandler again:
<sqf>findDisplay 46 displayRemoveEventHandler ["KeyDown", _myEH];</sqf>
( if obviously that private variable is known to the script environment you are referencing <sqf inline>_myEH</sqf> in )
</dd>

</dl>
